security_and_recovery.scheduler_scope: The candidate suite revalidates cron/misfire catch-up, durable cursor/fire idempotence, leadership takeover/fencing, restartable execution outbox, cancellation, timeout, daemon shutdown and notification retry/provider failure paths. New negative coverage proves conflicting notification IDs fail closed, provider error text is redacted/bounded, and scheduler/notification lifecycle limits reject unsafe numeric values. No provider certification is inferred from SQLite tests.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: RONIN_POSTGRES_TEST_DSN is absent, so PostgreSQL scheduler persistence and operator/provider qualification remain pending/blocked. No mock was counted as PostgreSQL evidence.
